_readme: Flags drawn as pixel art, so this project depends on no icon licence.
A national flag is an official symbol, not a copyrighted work; what is licensed in the
usual icon sets is their SVG artwork. These are ours.
ONE grid for every flag: 16 wide, 11 tall. A square or 2:1 flag is normalised into it —
at the size these are shown (12-16 px) the distortion is invisible and one box keeps every
renderer identical. '.' is transparent, for the one flag that is not a rectangle.
Each row is exactly 16 characters, each character is a key of that flag's palette or '.'.
These are deliberately NOT faithful reproductions. At sixteen pixels wide an emblem is a
patch of the right colour in the right place, which is what every icon set ships.
